chapter: Biddle, Durham and early road shows
title: Leading the band in a Pigmeat Markham show
summary: He led the band for a small touring show starring Pigmeat Markham around the South until it disbanded back in Durham.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, no. I stayed in Durham for a good little while, then we got -- I got with the show playing -- leading the band with a little show starring Pigmeat Markham.
Yes. Pigmeat Markham was the star of that show. I traveled around for a while and then --
Yes, all around in the south. Then we came back to Durham -- the show came back to Durham and made up there in Durham to travel all around and came back. Then the show disbanded.
